cells.tense: You are at the table with the pen, and feeling is moving before anything has been named.
cells.act: let yourself be drawn before you choose
cells.ask: Notice someone you already feel something toward. Be pulled toward them before you decide what it means. No verdict, no announcement, and no name required for a good while yet.
cells.core:
You don't need a name for a feeling to have it. The pull shows up first and the label comes later, and these days you mostly let that order stand. People near you get read before they finish their sentence, and what they get from you is warmth, not a ruling.

What's left to use is one person. Be drawn toward them before you decide anything about it, the way a room gets warmer before you notice why. This isn't a feeling you'd be naming too soon, and it isn't one you'd be rationing. It keeps going because you let it lead a little, and nothing fuses to it — you stay yourself inside the pull. Nothing needs saying yet.
cells.sheetLine: The feeling arrives before you've found its name.
cells.verb: receiving what is here before there is a name for it
cells.place: the place where what you already are comes through undimmed

cells.tense: Bracing has gotten out ahead of the feeling, and the verdict lands before the thing is here.
cells.act: complete the form so it stands without you
cells.ask: Finish something you already decided on, get it to where it stands by itself, then stop tending it. Solid, done this week, no improvements afterward.
cells.core:
The pull arrives and you're already deciding what it's for. Feelings get scheduled, and warmth gets aimed at things that haven't happened yet. What other people bring you is met with the management of it before the meeting of it, and they feel the difference even when they can't name it.

Finish the thing, let it stand without your hands on it. That's the practice: same muscle, other side — a thing is done, it works, and it doesn't need your eyes anymore. Feelings need that kind of rest too. After it holds a while untended, you'll have proof that not-tending isn't neglect, and you can bring that back to what's warm around you.
cells.sheetLine: You meet the future before you finish meeting the person.
cells.verb: receiving what is here before there is a name for it
cells.place: the place where what you already are comes through undimmed

cells.tense: The door was open some time back and you're still standing there, waiting on a feeling already offered.
cells.act: carry what the spark became to its full size
cells.ask: Take something that stayed possible — small is fine — and carry it to finished this month. A made article, not a plan. Show one person once it stands.
cells.core:
Somewhere the receiving got left, and now the warmth runs low and arrives late. People notice you're kind and quiet and not quite here, and the not-quite-here is what they take home. It isn't that feeling stopped; it's that it got postponed, and the postponement became the habit.

Take something that was only ever possible and finish it. Not a plan — the made article, standing where you can point at it. That's the way back in: finishing something teaches you it was yours to finish. Once it stands, show one person. Their seeing it is part of the whole thing, not extra credit.
cells.sheetLine: The warmth runs low because the receiving got postponed.

cells.tense: The room opens up around you without your say-so, and you'd say you're just someone who listens.
cells.act: let the exchange with someone run both ways
cells.ask: Give one true thing to someone you trust, then take one true thing back. Let it run both ways once. Whatever they offer is the offer.
cells.core:
You've been the reason people cry in the kitchen after good parties. You open things up by being there, and your account of it is that you're not doing anything, that it happens around you. It doesn't. Someone is doing it, and that someone keeps saying they were just standing nearby.

Run one exchange both directions: give someone a true thing, then take the true thing they hand back. It's the smallest version of the same thing done plainly. Whatever they offer is the offer; taking it is the whole ask. When it's done, don't total up who owes what — that arithmetic is how what you gave stays invisible.
